title: Save the official Cainiao Express parcel's tracking number to a Notes note
instruction: 打开菜鸟。菜鸟速递官方那件手机尾号包裹的运单号记到笔记「官方件单号」。

steps.thought:
Alright, the core objective here is clear: I need to get the tracking number for a specific Cainiao Express package and store it securely. The package is identified by a phone number suffix, and it's from "Cainiao Express Official." I'm tasked with saving this tracking number into a note labeled "官方件单号" (Official Package Tracking Number).

To begin, the most logical first step is to access the necessary tool. That means opening the "菜鸟" (Cainiao) application. I can achieve this directly by invoking the `open_app` function and specifying "菜鸟" as the target application. This will bring up the Cainiao app interface, allowing me to proceed with the search.

The user wants to find the tracking number of a package from "菜鸟速递官方" (Cainiao Express Official) with a "手机尾号" (phone number suffix) and save it to a note named "官方件单号".
I am currently on the Cainiao app home page.
I can see a package "到站包裹" (Arrived package) which is "极兔速递" (J&T Express).
I can see "近日签收" (Recently signed) packages.
I should scroll down to find the package from "菜鸟速递官方".

I see the package "手机尾号1234的包裹" (Package with phone number suffix 1234) from "菜鸟速递" (Cainiao Express).
I need to click on it to get the tracking number.

The tracking number is CN2026778812901.
I need to copy it. There is a "复制" (Copy) button next to it.
The tracking number is copied. Now I need to open the Notes app and save it.

I need to create a new note with the title "官方件单号" and the content being the tracking number I just copied (CN2026778812901).
I can use the `notes__create_note` tool to do this directly.
The note has been created successfully. I can terminate the task.
